appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Additional Top Stores: Ad Spend vs Sales'.
Five blue circular markers are plotted, each labeled with a store name above the point.
Markers form a clear upward diagonal trend; Store 6 is lowest-left, Store 10 is highest-right.
Store 6 is near x=30, y=66; Store 7 near x=40, y=93; Store 8 near x=50, y=121; Store 9 near x=60, y=148; Store 10 near x=70, y=176.
Each successive store (6→10) lies above and to the right of the previous one on the same series.

printed_facts.fact: Axis label 'Sales ($ thousands)'; ticks 60 through 180 in steps of 10.
Header text 'Additional Top Stores: Ad Spend vs Sales'.
Review record option is 'Additional top-store request'; Recommendation area option is 'Store ad budget'.

public_definitions: Primary field 'Budget Recommendation' with options: 'Hold and request full-store analysis', 'Approve broader ad budget increase', 'Keep current ad budgets unchanged'.
Companion selects must be set to 'Store ad budget', 'Additional top-store request', and 'Store budget review' respectively.
uncertain: No explicit threshold or policy table is shown to define when an 'increase' is approved versus 'hold'; the decision must be inferred from the positive ad-spend/sales relationship.
Exact numeric values for each store are read visually from gridlines, not printed as data annotations.
